captions.instagram:
Two wardrobes in a loft in Palmers Green: IKEA PAX inside, MDF outside.

The frames went in first, then MDF panels closed the gaps to the ceiling and the walls, sloping wall included, with full-height doors across the front. Open them and it's all IKEA: easy to get parts for and easy to change later.

My 22-page guide, IKEA PAX, built in, has the sums, the cut list and every step. Link in bio.
